'''Golden leggings''' are [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from seven [[gold ingot]]s.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give {{Value|Golden Leggings|armor}} armor and have {{Value|Golden Leggings|durability}} durability (vanilla: 105). The full golden set gives 12 armor, less than iron but more than copper, and piglins accept it as usual.

=== Enchantments ===
Each piece has [[Fire Protection]]: II on the crown, leggings and boots and III on the chestplate. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

They melt down into one gold ingot in a [[blast furnace]].
